description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing improved performance, security patches, and new language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Fix any compilation issues or deprecated API usages introduced by the Java 25 migration.
